note: Uses the atlas uncertainty group. Edges use the atlas nodes bayes and probability.

title.zh: 假设检验与 p 值

description.zh: 以抛硬币为例：p 值是零假设为真时出现至少同样极端结果的概率；α 是第一类错误的预算，功效 1 − β 随效应与样本量上升；同时做多次检验总会碰到“显著”，需要校正。精确二项检验模型，p 值不是假设为真的概率。
description.en: With coin flips: the p-value is the probability, if the null is true, of a result at least as extreme; α is the budget for type I errors, power 1 − β grows with effect and sample size, and running many tests always turns up something “significant”, so corrections are needed. An exact binomial test model; a p-value is not the probability that the hypothesis is true.

formula: p = P(result at least as extreme | H₀)

label.zh: 用概率分布判断“是否太罕见”
label.en: Using a distribution to judge “too rare”

reason.zh: 检验把“如果硬币公平，这个结果有多罕见”换成一个由二项分布算出的概率，这是概率分布在推断上的直接应用。
reason.en: A test turns “how rare would this result be if the coin were fair” into a probability computed from the binomial distribution, a direct use of probability distributions in inference.

reason.zh: p 值回答“若假设为真，数据这么极端的概率”；贝叶斯回答“给定数据，假设为真的概率”，需要先验。两者经常被混为一谈。
reason.en: A p-value answers “if the hypothesis is true, how probable is data this extreme”; Bayes answers “given the data, how probable is the hypothesis”, which needs a prior. The two are often confused.

ask.zh: p 值是零假设为真时出现至少同样极端结果的概率——p = 0.03 是说零假设为真的概率是 3% 吗？
ask.en: The p-value is the probability, if the null is true, of a result at least as extreme — does p = 0.03 mean the null has a 3% chance of being true?

ask.zh: α 是第一类错误的预算——同时做多次检验，总会碰到“显著”，为什么需要校正？
ask.en: α is the budget for type-I errors — running many tests at once will hit “significant” by chance, so why is correction needed?

ask.zh: p 值和贝叶斯的后验概率有什么区别？哪个直接回答“假设为真吗”？
ask.en: How does a p-value differ from a Bayesian posterior? Which one directly answers “is the hypothesis true?”?

reveal.zh: p 值不是假设为真的概率，只是零假设下极端结果的概率；α 是犯第一类错误的预算，多次检验不校正就会假阳性泛滥。
reveal.en: A p-value is not the probability the hypothesis is true, only the probability of an extreme result under the null; α budgets type-I errors, and uncorrected multiple testing floods you with false positives.
